findings.reason: The Postulate gives the period curve and separately adopts the local model’s function u(A_D), but never identifies the monopole point u_m with Λ², the local scalar A_D with the period a_D(u), or u(A_D) with its local inverse branch. Add this source-qualified identification and nonzero local derivative; Seiberg–Witten explicitly gives the monopole superpotential and a_D proportional to u−1 near the singularity ([§§4.6–5](https://arxiv.org/html/hep-th/9407087)).

The Definition uses an arbitrary Lie-algebra basis in D_a but defines V_tree with the unweighted sum ΣD_a². Fix an Ad-invariant positive inner product and an orthonormal generator basis, or include the corresponding inverse metric, so the stated gauge-model potential is basis-independent and gauge-invariant.

The vacuum-moduli supplier defines its F/D zero locus for canonical scalar kinetic terms, while this local model gives A_D kinetic coefficient g_D⁻². In the Verification, explicitly use A_can=A_D/g_D and F_Acan=g_D F_AD (or establish the equivalent positive-metric zero-set argument) before applying that supplier.

Proof step 1.1 bounds (s−ξ)² by d²+4|x+U₀|², but the following stated C_V coefficients use d²+4|H|²+4K²|a|². Use the sharper reverse-triangle bound d²+2|x+U₀|², then |x+U₀|²=|H−δ|²≤2|H|²+2K²|a|²; this yields the existing C_V without changing the claim.
